title: AIT-GUI route chain allows unauthenticated Python execution in server process (CVE-2026-77309)
description: CVE-2026-77309 is a high-severity vulnerability in the AIT-GUI server (versions >=1.0.0 <2.5.1) that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary Python code. The flaw arises because the server writes user-controlled input to a static file and then executes that file as Python code without proper path restrictions. This enables attackers with network access to run code with daemon privileges without authentication. The issue is fixed in version 2.5.1 by restricting script execution paths and avoiding static temporary files.
